name: OpenLain5G
description: OpenLain5G is a reproducible research environment for deploying, managing, and validating integrated laboratory 4G LTE/VoLTE and 5G SA/VoNR networks, plus an experimental 5G NSA profile. It integrates existing open-source components with configuration, orchestration, validation, run traceability, RF safeguards, and a FastAPI/React interface.
